tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// rdo rje mkha' 'gro la brten pa'i sdig sbyong sbyin sreg gi cho ga sgrib gnyis kun 'joms zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gu ru badz+ra ḍā ka na mā mi/ thog med sgrib pa'i tshang tshing kun// ye shes me lces skad cig la// sreg byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro la// btung nas sgrib sbyong lag len dgod// de'ang rgyud chen rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i le'u bzhi bcu rtsa drug par slob ma rjes gzung gi skabs su/ slob ma yi ni rkang mthil du// gzhu 'dra rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsam// lte bar ye shes me 'bar bas// de yi 'od zer snying gar 'bar// 'bar bas snying gar 'khrigs par bsgom// kaṃ las byung ba'i mi sdug gzugs// sdig pa sna yi sgo nas byung*// de nas khro bo'i gzugs bsgoms la// des ni kun nas za bar bsgom// oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ mngon brjod bla ma'i rgyud las/ ngo bo rdo rje gnod sbyin la rnam pa zad byed mkha' 'gro zhes pa'i dkyil 'khor ram gtso rkyang me nang du bsgoms pa la til bsregs nas sdig pa sbyong ba'i tshul gsal bar gsungs pa'i man ngag rje btsun sa skya pa la bka' babs pa lam 'bras kyi cha lag las 'byung ba nyid rang gi sgrib sbyong gi ched du nyams su len pa la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po ni/ 'byor ldan gyis dngul lam rdza las byas pa'i zhi ba'i thab khung mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du me khrol blugs pa'i steng du/ 'dzom na rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sku brnyan sbubs stong bzhag 'di ni dmigs pa gsal ba'i ched tsam yin pas ma 'dzoms na mi dgos/ 'byor pas mi lcogs na kham phor la sogs snod zlum po dkar po'i nang du me blug snod gcig tu bsreg rdzas til nag ji tsam 'os pa bzhag mdun gyi stegs bur chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod bsham/

mdun du nang mchod rdo rje dang dril bu rnams nye bar bsdogs la/ thog mar mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ rang nyid thun mtshams kyi lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu bas las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ sogs shab+da'i bar brjod/ nang mchod oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥs brlab/ skyabs 'gro ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus kyi mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sems bskyed ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum/ rdor sems sgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud/

rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang 'dra'i rigs bdag gi dbu rgyan can/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs/ he ru ka'i sku gang*/ de nas dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi sku thams cad las bdud rtsi babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang rkang thil gnyis nas thon nas shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ oṃ

rdo rje khrag 'thung dam tshig rjes su skyongs/ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ he khrag 'thung nyid kyis nye bar gnas par mdzod/ ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha ba/ bdag la brtan par mdzad du gsol/ su to ṣ+yo me bha ba/ bdag la shin tu dges par mdzod/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ bdag la rjes su chags par mdzod/ su poṣ+yo me bha ba/ bdag la shin tu rgyas par mdzod/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsol/ sarba karma su tsa me/ las kun la yang bdag gi ni/ tsit+taṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ sems la dge legs su ni mdzod/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wān/ bcom ldan rdo rje khrag 'thung*// bdag grol khrag 'thung nyid du mdzod// dam tshig sems dpa' chen po āḥ badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha ba/ mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus kyi mthar/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang ltung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu ste/ spyi bo nas rang la thim pas/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur gyur/ ces mos/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi thab dang lha bskyed pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shud+dho3haṃ/ gis thab khung*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po/ rgyar khru gang pa/ zabs su khru phyed pa/ kha khyer dang mu ran sor bzhi pa la rdo rje rtse lnga pa zlum pos mtshan pa/

nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la ram̐/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu bsnol ba mthe'u rtsa ba'i yig rnying las so chung sbrel te sdigs mdzub brkyangs pas 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum pa zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa 'phags pa rin po che'i yig cha las so/ dang rin po che dang klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs bsnams pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyi ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po bsam/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥbarjod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdabyer med du bstim/ slar yang hūm̐ las 'od 'phros de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lngas oṃ badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ/

puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ nang mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis 'bul/ bstod pa ni/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod// gang gi thugs rje me phung 'bar ba'i mthus// chags sogs nyes pa'i bud shing kun sreg cing*// bde chen ye shes snang ba rgyas mdzad pa// bcom ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhabs la 'dud// de nas mdun du til 'du byas nas/ rang gi rkang mthil du yam̐ las rlung*/ lte bar gtum mo'i me/ snying gar kam̐ rlung gis me bskyod pas snying ga'i sdig pa'i sa bon kam̐ nag po la/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad bsdus/ sna sgo gnyis nas sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par thon/ mdun gyi til la thim/ de bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhal du phul bas rigs rtsa ba'i yi ger/ drug gi skye gnas kyi bag chags sogs sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad zad par bsams la/ lag pa g.yas pa mtheb srin sbyar ba'i bar du til bzung la bskor ba'i tshul gyis thab tu phul la/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmin ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan brgya rtsa brgyad 'bul/ thog ma dang tha mar/ 'phags pa rin po che'i yig cha las so/ bhasmin ku ru zhes pa'i rjes/ bdag gi sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ grib ma'i nyes pa dang*/ nad dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa'i spel tshig kyang sbyar/ de ni tshar gcig bya ba'i tshul yin la sdig sbyong ched du bya ba'i skabs thun re la de 'dra stong phrag la sogs pa ji tsam nus pa grangs gsog thun bar du mjug bsdu zhing slar thun la 'jug pa'i tshe mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams bskyar te bya ba yin no// de'ang sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags spyi dang mtshungs par rab dngos/

'bring nyams/ tha ma rmi lam du lus las dri ma mang po'am khrag rnag don pa dang*/ khrus byed pa dang*/ gos dkar po gyon pa sogs ltas bzang yid ches pa yang yang ma byung gi bar du bya ba yin no// gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ thun 'jog pa na gong ltar sngags kyis mchod cing bstod/ bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang*/ dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pas gsol ba gdab/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsams la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'khod par shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba// de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces sogs dge ba bsngo/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa ci rigs kyis mtha' brgyan/ me thab mi 'gom pa'i gtsang sar bzhag thal ba chu bor dor bas chu la gnas pa'i srog chags rnams kyi sdig sgrib dag par gsung*/ 'dis sdig sgrib dang dam tshig nyams chags thams cad sel zhing grib sel dang rigs drug gnas sbyong gi mchog yin par gsungs so// las ngan sgrib pa'i chings ba yis// mtha' med srid par bcings pa kun// ye shes rdo rje'i mes bsregs nas// rnam grol bde chen gnas thob shog /ces pa'ang rje bla ma thams cad gzigs pa chen po 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i dgongs bzhed ltar 'phags pa rin po che dang ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rab sor bzhag ste gsal byed nag 'gros kyi tshul du rmongs brtul blo gros mtha' yas kyi tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub gnas su bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/

bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
